name: 土台龟
description: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

moves.name: 撞击
moves.description: 用整个身体 撞向对手进行攻击。

moves.name: 树叶
moves.description: 将叶片打向对手， 进行攻击。

moves.name: 咬住
moves.description: 用尖锐的牙 咬住对手进行攻击。 有时会使对手畏缩。

moves.name: 重踏
moves.description: 用力踩踏地面并攻击 自己周围所有的宝可梦。 降低对方的速度。

moves.name: 催眠粉
moves.description: 撒出催眠粉， 从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。

moves.name: 叶刃
moves.description: 像用剑一般操纵叶片 切斩对手进行攻击。 容易击中要害。

moves.name: 舍身冲撞
moves.description: 拼命地猛撞向对手进行攻击。 自己也会受到不小的伤害。

moves.name: 木槌
moves.description: 用坚硬的躯体 撞击对手进行攻击。 自己也会受到不小的伤害。

moves.name: Headlong Rush
moves.description: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s defensive stats.
